title: Terms and Conditions
introduction: Last updated: November 12, 2026. Welcome to Tripling (the “Platform”). These Terms govern access to and use of our travel companion website. By registering, you agree to these Terms and acknowledge the Privacy Policy. If you do not agree, do not create an account or use the service.

sections.heading: 1. Nature of service and responsibility
paragraphs: Tripling, operated by {{operator}}, is a peer-to-peer venue for independent travelers to post plans and connect with potential companions. The operator’s contact is {{contact}}. The platform does not operate or manage vehicles, transport services, carpooling operations, tours, or tour guiding, and does not act as a travel agent or a partner of a traveler.

The platform is intended to perform an intermediary role. Any protection under Section 79 of India’s Information Technology Act, 2000 depends on applicable law and the relevant legal conditions; describing the service as an intermediary does not itself establish immunity.

Travel can involve injury, illness, emergencies, theft, financial fraud, accidents, delays, cancellations, harassment, disputes, or illegal conduct by others. Make your own informed decisions about companions and travel arrangements. The operator does not guarantee another person’s conduct, a trip’s availability, or a third-party provider’s performance.

To the extent permitted by applicable law, the operator is not responsible for losses caused by independent travelers or providers outside its control. These Terms do not create “zero liability” or exclude responsibility, remedies, or consumer protections that cannot lawfully be excluded. Liability for a particular claim depends on the facts and applicable law.

Optional city suggestions are provided by Google Maps Platform. Use of Google Places features is subject to the Google Maps/Google Earth Additional Terms of Service at https://maps.google.com/help/terms_maps/ and Google Privacy Policy at https://policies.google.com/privacy. Suggestions may be incomplete or inaccurate; confirm your intended city and meeting arrangements independently.

sections.heading: 2. User eligibility and accounts
paragraphs: You must be at least eighteen (18) years old to register and participate. Age is self-confirmed rather than independently verified. Give accurate information, keep your login credentials confidential, and report suspected unauthorized use to {{contact}}.

Signup uses an email address and password. Password confirmation and acceptance of the current Terms and Privacy Policy are required. You are responsible for activity you authorize through your account; applicable law determines responsibility for unauthorized activity.

Organizers review join requests. Women-only trip eligibility is based on self-declared profile information and is checked when a traveler requests to join and when the organizer approves. It is not identity verification or a safety certification.

First and last name are mandatory for registration and participation. Existing accounts must complete these fields before creating or joining trips. Optional Google sign-in requires a verified Google email, age confirmation and policy acceptance for new accounts. To connect an existing password account, sign in first and select the matching Google account from your profile.

sections.heading: 3. Identity and government ID verification
paragraphs: Government ID upload, third-party KYC processing, and verified-profile badges are not currently available. Do not upload or paste Aadhaar, driving-license, voter-ID, passport, or other identity-document information into trip descriptions, requests, or chat.

If identity verification is introduced, the operator must explain the verification provider, data requested, purpose, retention, safeguards, and applicable consent before collecting documents. No claim is made that such a system is already operating or compliant with a particular legal standard.

A future verification result would be an identity signal only, not a background check or a guarantee of character, safety, or reliability. Get to know companions, discuss expectations, and meet in a public place before committing. Do not exchange or retain unnecessary copies of another person’s identity documents.

sections.heading: 4. Data privacy and legal requests
paragraphs: The Privacy Policy explains the information currently collected, visibility of public travel plans, member-only communication, service-provider processing, and requests for correction or deletion. Account email addresses and password hashes are not included in public listings.

The operator must assess and meet applicable obligations under India’s Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023 and other applicable laws and rules. This policy is not a certification of compliance, and consent for a future government-ID service is not obtained merely by accepting these Terms.

The operator may disclose information in response to legally valid requests, orders, or other lawful requirements. Disclosures and any notice to affected people must be assessed under applicable law; a complaint alone does not provide unrestricted authority to disclose all account or chat information.

sections.heading: 5. Fees, transactions, and refunds
paragraphs: The current website does not charge registration or platform-access fees and does not collect payments. If an access or registration fee is introduced later, its amount, purpose, payment terms, and cancellation/refund rules must be disclosed before payment and accepted where required.

A future platform fee would not itself be payment for transport, accommodation, or a tour. Any refund restrictions must remain subject to statutory rights and cannot override a refund or other remedy required by law.

Tripling does not facilitate payments between travelers for fuel, tolls, accommodation, or shared expenses. Travelers should agree on arrangements clearly and check providers before paying. The platform does not provide escrow, payment protection, or a guarantee that a companion will repay an expense.

sections.heading: 6. Prohibited conduct and safe participation
paragraphs: Do not post fake, misleading, fraudulent, or criminal travel plans; harass, stalk, threaten, abuse, or intimidate others; discriminate unlawfully; impersonate someone; harvest contact information; spam; or distribute malware or disruptive code.

Do not use the service for unauthorized commercial taxi or tour operations, sexual exploitation, human trafficking, or other illegal activities. Respect personal boundaries, local laws, and destination communities.

Keep exact home addresses, government IDs, financial information, and precise live locations out of public listings. Review budgets, transport, accommodation, health considerations, and local conditions independently. Use public meeting points.
Reports are recorded for operator follow-up; they do not provide emergency response or continuous monitoring. For an emergency in India, call 112 or contact local emergency services.

sections.heading: 7. Content, membership, suspension, and changes
paragraphs: You retain ownership of content you submit and give the operator permission to store, process, and display it as needed to provide the platform, address reports, and meet legal obligations. Share only content you have the right to provide.

Trip listings and published reviews are public. Introductions are shared with the organizer, and messages are shared with registered group members. Reviews should be truthful and focus on travel behavior, communication, and reliability. A membership record does not independently prove that travel occurred.

Published trip records cannot be deleted. Verified organizers or administrators may cancel an open trip with a reason, retaining history and notifying members. Participation cancellation is subject to the 24-hour departure restriction and support exceptions described below; pending join requests may be withdrawn. Organizer duties transfer to another active registered member; if none remain, requests close and the record stays available. Leaving revokes future group-chat access. Past or canceled trip chats are read-only; retained reviews remain available. Registered participation overlapping the trip dates is required to review another eligible participant after a trip ends. Keep independent booking and emergency information.

The operator may investigate complaints and restrict or suspend access where reasonably necessary for safety, security, legal requirements, or violations of these Terms. Notice, reasons, and opportunities to challenge a decision should be provided where required or appropriate. Contact {{contact}} to raise a complaint or question a restriction.

Updates are versioned and dated. Signup records the versions accepted. Material changes affecting existing users must be communicated and any further consent required by law obtained; continued use is not treated as a substitute for legally required consent.

Any signed-in traveler may block another traveler with a category and a reason of at least 20 characters. Choose a private block or share the reason only with registered participants of one trip both travelers participated in. Do not include private contact information, identity documents, threats or knowingly false allegations. Shared reasons are statements by their authors, not verified findings. Participants can report a statement. Blocks hide messages between the affected travelers and prevent new group requests or approvals involving them; existing membership remains until a traveler leaves. Only the author can unblock through the app.

sections.heading: 8. Governing law, jurisdiction, and contact
paragraphs: These Terms are governed by the laws of India. Subject to mandatory consumer rights, other statutory protections, and the jurisdiction of competent courts or tribunals required by law, disputes are intended to be brought before the competent courts in Chandigarh, India.

Contact {{contact}} about a dispute, privacy concern, grievance, or account-closure request. We encourage contacting the operator first to try to resolve a concern, without limiting a right to approach a regulator or another legally available forum.

sections.heading: Organizer approval, cancellations and community submissions
paragraphs: Organizers must obtain application approval before publishing or managing trips. A Verified Organizer badge records an application decision, not government identity verification, guaranteed competence, insurance or a guarantee of safety. Administrators review submitted references and may approve or reject requests with a reason. Optional supporting documents must not contain government IDs.

New trips require a confirmed starting city and an actual departure time with timezone. A participant cannot cancel active participation within 24 hours of departure, including exactly 24 hours. Contact abhishek@tripling.in for exceptional requests; administrators must record a reason. Missing legacy departure times must be confirmed rather than inferred. Completed or canceled memberships can be ended. Verified organizers may cancel an open trip with a reason; records are retained and active participants are notified.

Only confirmed participants whose participation overlaps a completed trip may review its organizer. Self-reviews and duplicate trip reviews are prohibited. Administrators can hide abusive reviews with a recorded moderation reason. Testimonials are voluntary and require explicit consent for name/message/trip-title publication plus administrator approval. Withdraw publication consent or request correction through the support contact.

Feedback submissions are private to authorized operators. Do not include passwords, government IDs, payment details or other unnecessary sensitive information. Feedback is not an emergency channel and does not guarantee an immediate response.
